title: Newer Holiday Special
name: Newer_W_Holiday_Special_1.12.zip
description: New Super Mario Bros. Wii level mod for Wii/vWii, supplied as a full patch bundle.
requirements: Wii U vWii Homebrew Channel, Riivolution1.06 or later, and your New Super Mario Bros. Wii retail disc. Use only game IDs accepted by the included Riivolution XML; no game image is supplied.
setup: Extract the entire original archive preserving its mod data folder and riivolution XML at SD root. Launch Riivolution from vWii HBC with your disc inserted, select this patch and launch. Disable the patch or move its folder off SD to undo; preserve saves and original ZIP.
